description: A component implementation. The record key IS the NSID the component implements, so a host resolves a name to the first DID in the import stack that publishes it. Inlay-shaped (https://github.com/danabra/inlay) under our own namespace; interop with at.inlay.component is a read/convert, not the storage shape.

main.description: Component record. The rkey is the type NSID this component implements, e.g. at://{did}/ing.lexicon.ui.component/dev.cssints.ui.stack.

body.description: How this component is rendered. Omit for a primitive the host implements itself.

view.description: What data this component views and which prop receives it.

imports.description: Ordered DID import stack for this component's subtree. For each NSID, the first DID that publishes a component with that rkey wins. Overrides the tenant's default order for this subtree.

updatedAt.description: Last update. Set by the publish flow to bust cached reads.

bodyExternal.description: The component is rendered by calling a remote XRPC endpoint.

did.description: DID of the service hosting this component.

personalized.description: When true the host sends a signed JWT identifying the viewer with each call.

bodyTemplate.description: The host renders the component from a serialized element tree with bindings.

node.description: Serialized element tree, not interpreted by this lexicon.

view.description: Declares what data this component views and which prop receives it.

prop.description: Which component prop receives the view data.

viewRecord.description: The component views records of a collection. Omit collection for any collection; an rkey makes it accept a bare DID.

collection.description: The collection this component views. Omit for any collection.

rkey.description: Record key baked from the collection's lexicon. Present enables DID expansion.

viewPrimitive.description: The component views a primitive value.
